notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 is out!
notes.content:
Hey all, we've just released a small update adding support to additional languages and with some minor bug fixes!

[list]
[*] The game is now localized in [b]Spanish, French, Traditional Chinese, German, and Japanese![/b],
[*] Added d-pad support to select a character before the run.,
[*] [b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed QuickLeaf Boots issue where if both characters had the boots, whenever one of the character upgraded their boots the other one would lose their buff.
[*] [b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed language not being saved after changing it in the options menu.
[/list]

As always thanks for all the positive feedback so far!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
This patch brings some small changes we were able to address right away!

The main change is the removal of character swapping in single-player mode. After seeing how it impacted gameplay, we decided it wasn’t improving the experience as intended. Let us know if you have any thoughts on this change!

[b]Changes[/b]:
[list]
[*] Removed the ability to swap character controls in single-player mode.
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]:
[list]
[*] Fixed issues that could prevent completing the [i]Juice Extravaganza[/i] and [i]Pest Control[/i] achievements.
[*] Corrected small text errors in some cards.
[/list]

notes.title: - New Update - Steam Remote Play Together
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We are part of the Remote Play Together Fest! And because of that, we decided to release a new update to our demo! 

This update includes:

[list]
[*] New Sauce: Shocking Mustard - When hitting enemies you have the chance to create electric attacks that jump to nearby enemies and deal damage to them.

[*] New Item: Smackback Helmet - When you take damage, you deal damage to neaby enemies too.

[*] New Item: Veggie Puff Pump - Makes all your attacks bigger!

[*] Reroll Feature: Now you can refresh your upgrade options during level up! You can reroll up to 3 times per run to find that card you are looking for.

[*] New Elite Enemies behaviors and art.

[*] Balancing adjustments.
[/list]

Go call a friend and play together locally or online (with remote play)!

notes.title: New Single-Player Mode!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

We have just updated the demo with the new [b]Single-Player Mode! [/b]
Some players mentioned that they were having trouble playing alone and gave great feedbacks to help us improve the solo mode.
 We took every of these feedbacks into consideration and made major changes to deliver a better experience for the [b]Single-Player Mode[/b] and reach the same level of fun as the [b]Co-Op Mode.[/b]

Here is what is different on the Solo Mode:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44246935/d183c32cd8680a7a241921732f7dc7321dc21545.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44246935/c5eb6db2334653a25947faea2e88f69bc7795e8e.png[/img]

Give this mode a try and tell us what you think!

We also have made some other small changes, listed below:
[list]
[*] Burst Amount of Banana Sword renamed to Multi Slash.
[*] Increased camera field of view.
[*] Balance Changes (Root of the Problem, Fertilizing Elixir, Cherry Mutant and Vinechain knockback).
[/list]

We intend to keep updating the demo to give you the best experience as posible and we would love to keep receiving your feedbacks so we can create Vinebound together!

Best regards,
Vinebound Team

notes.title: Get to know the mighty Food Weapons!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

Here we will show a little about the weapons that our Bloom Buddies can use to defeat the Moldy Horde.

[list]
[*]The first one is the Strawberry Rod. It creates a magic ray that connects one player to another. Players must coordinate their movement to make enemies stay inside that ray, dealing damage while its active!
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExMWVmb2FtcG4wczgyeGZ6NjZ5eWEwdjEydDExYWl5d2d4bGwyOTNtbiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/LjbQIVEaejFwGFi2bC/giphy.gif[/img]

[*] The second one is the Bow & Carrot. Each player shoots arrows in both directions, but one character shoots vertically and the other horizontally. Upgrading it can make the players shoot lots of carrots, almost becoming their own bullet-hells!
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExOW1scTZtemVmaTI2MnZiNTZ1bHFvM2p5NHVnODNqbm14Nm5tYTByaSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/bOwNZKCRgWvtLxjBP1/giphy.gif[/img]

[*] The third one is the Banana Sword. It creates a sword slash in the opposite direction of the other player. It's a great weapon to deal critical hits and keep enemies away with its knockback.
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExODdyOXQ3czQwbXJ0OXVsajl0NTVkMjVndTRybjU0bXpvdzd2cGF2ZiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/BOxMlEwDW9XMPPJtcP/giphy.gif[/img]

[*] The fourth one is the Pumpkin Bomb. It creates bombs that explode when the cooldown reaches the other player, dealing a lot of damage and knockback. Upgrading it can make you drop lots of bombs, raise the explosion area and raise its damage even more.
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExa24zcWE5M2lpMGxlb3gwdXNxemFyNzRxZ2QwZzgyZnZrdzA0ZnEzcyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/1F4IwDlV7zfKAnrsq6/giphy.gif[/img]
[/list]

We are working now on even more Food Weapons, do you have an idea for a new weapon? Share it with us!
